records.title: Hyperspectral Image Denoising via Spatial-Spectral Recurrent Transformer
records.abstractLevel: official arXiv abstract for related preprint
records.abstractSummary: SSRT-UNet integrates global spectral correlation and non-local spatial self-similarity in a spatial–spectral recurrent block; spectral Transformer/RNN recurs across bands while the spatial branch shares keys and values.

records.title: Iterative Low-Rank Network for Hyperspectral Image Denoising
records.abstractSummary: ILRNet embeds a rank minimization module in U-Net, applies learned singular-value thresholding to low-frequency wavelet features, and iteratively fuses intermediate denoised outputs with noisy inputs.

records.title: Material-Guided Multiview Fusion Network for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
records.abstractSummary: MMF-Net fuses false-color, HSI and unmixing-derived material views, uses cross-material attention, and aggregates intra-view and cross-view long-range dependencies.

records.title: Prototypical Network With Residual Capsule for Few-Shot Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractSummary: PN-ResCapsNet combines a prototypical network with residual capsules, self-attention and inter-/intra-class bias reduction; the public abstract reports KSC, HT and PU experiments.
